<h>Lectio 3</h>
<c>C</c>ommemorántur hódie mártyres ex província Philippinárum órdinis Prædicatórum, qui anno millésimo nongentésimo nono albo Beatórum adscrípti sunt, quíque sǽculis décimo octávo et nono in regiónibus Indo-Sinénsibus triumphárunt: imprímis, anno millésimo septingentésimo quadragésimo quinto, Francíscus Gil de Féderich et Matthæus Alónso Lenziniána; deinde, viginti et octo elápsis annis, Hyacínthus Castañéda, vicárius apostólicus, et Vincéntius Liem a Pace, primus Prædicatórum indigenárum martyr. Quorum ex sanguine mártires non pauci sæculo sequénti splendide effloruerunt, quos inter recenséntur ex ordine Prædicatórum Hierónymus Hermosilla et Valentínus Bérrio-Ochóa, epíscopi; qui una cum Petro Almédo et Iosépho Kang, catechista indígena, anno millésimo octingentésimo sexagesimo primo, stolas suas in sanguine Agni lavérunt.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

* In sánguine Agni,

<r>℟.</r> In sánguine Agni,
<r>℣.</r> Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
<r>℟.</r> In sánguine Agni,

<r>Te Deum</r>
<c>T</c>e Deum laudámus: * te Dóminum confitémur.
Te ætérnum Patrem * omnis terra venerátur.
Tibi omnes Ángeli, * tibi Cæli, et univérsæ Potestátes:
Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim * incessábili voce proclámant:
<n>(Fit reverentia)</n> Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
Pleni sunt cæli et terra * maiestátis glóriæ tuæ.
Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus,
Te Prophetárum * laudábilis númerus,
Te Mártyrum candidátus * laudat exércitus.
Te per orbem terrárum * sancta confitétur Ecclésia,
Patrem * imménsæ maiestátis;
Venerándum tuum verum * et únicum Fílium;
Sanctum quoque * Paráclitum Spíritum.
Tu Rex glóriæ, * Christe.
Tu Patris * sempitérnus es Fílius.
<n>(Fit reverentia)</n> Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
Tu, devícto mortis acúleo, * aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum.
Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, * in glória Patris.
Iudex créderis * esse ventúrus.
<n>(Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus)</n> Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.
Ætérna fac cum Sanctis tuis * in glória numerári.
Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, * et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
Et rege eos, * et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
Per síngulos dies * benedícimus te.
<n>(Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem)</n> Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
Dignáre, Dómine, die isto * sine peccáto nos custodíre.
Miserére nostri, Dómine, * miserére nostri.
Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos, * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
In te, Dómine, sperávi: * non confúndar in ætérnum.

<h>P</h>atávii deposítio sancti Prosdócimi, qui fuit primus eiúsdem civitátis Epíscopus. Hic, a beáto Petro Apóstolo Epíscopus ordinátus, ad prædicándum Dei verbum ad prædíctam civitátem missus est; ibíque, multis virtútibus et prodígiis corúscans, beáto fine quiévit.
<h>P</h>erúsiæ sancti Herculáni, Epíscopi et Mártyris.
<h>A</h>pud Swelménsem civitátem, in Germánia, pássio sancti Engelbérti, Epíscopi Coloniénsis, qui, cum illuc ex óppido Sosátio ad templum dedicándum pérgeret, a sicáriis intercéptus in via multísque vulnéribus cæsus, gloriósum pro defensióne ecclesiásticæ libertátis et Románæ Ecclésiæ obediéntia martýrium súbiit.
<h>E</h>ódem die sancti Amaránthi Mártyris, qui apud Albigénsem urbem, in Gállia, exácto agónis fidélis cursu, sepúltus, vivit in glória.
<h>M</h>elitínæ, in Arménia, pássio sanctórum Hierónis, Nicándri, Hesýchii et aliórum trigínta; qui in persecutióne Diocletiáni, sub Lýsia Prǽside, coronáti sunt.
<h>A</h>mphípoli, in Macedónia, sanctórum Mártyrum Aucti, Tauriónis et Thessalonícæ.
<h>A</h>ncýræ, in Galátia, pássio sanctórum Melasíppi, Antónii et Carínæ, sub Iuliáno Apóstata.
<h>A</h>lexandríæ beáti Achíllæ Epíscopi, qui eruditióne, fide, conversatióne ac móribus fuit insígnis.
<h>I</h>n Frísia deposítio sancti Willibrórdi, Epíscopi Traiecténsis; qui, a beáto Sérgio Papa ordinátus Epíscopus, in Frísia et Dánia Evangélium prædicávit.
<h>M</h>etis, in Gállia, sancti Rufi, Epíscopi et Confessóris.

b.311c8d4bdd:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>N</c>ovember 7th 2027, the 8th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>A</h>t Padua, holy Prosdocimus, the first Bishop of that see, who was ordained Bishop by the blessed Apostle Peter, and sent to preach the Word of God in that city, where he shone with many graces and wonders, and died a blessed death.
<h>A</h>t Perugia, (in the year 547,) the holy martyr Herculanus, Bishop (of that see.)
<h>A</h>t Cologne, (in the year 1225,) holy Engelbert, Bishop (of that see), who was contented to suffer martyrdom in defence of the freedom of the Church and of the obedience due to the Church of Rome.
<h>O</h>n the same day the holy martyr Amaranth, who was buried in the city of Albi when the course of his faithful contending was over, but he is alive for evermore in glory.
<h>A</h>t Melitina, in Armenia, the holy martyrs Hiero, Nicander, Hesychius, and thirty others, who were crowned under the President Lysias, in the persecution under the Emperor Diocletian.
<h>A</h>t Amphipolis, in Macedonia, the holy martyrs Auctus, Taurion, and Thessalonica.
<h>A</h>t Ancyra, under the Emperor Julian the Apostate, the holy martyrs Melasippus, Anthony, and Carina.
<h>A</h>t Alexandria, (about the year 313,) blessed Achillas, Bishop (of that see,) eminent for his learning, faith, conversation, and life.
<h>I</h>n Friesland, (in the year 738,) holy Willebrord, (first) Bishop of Utrecht, who was ordained Bishop by blessed Pope Sergius, and preached the Gospel in Friesland and Denmark, whose feast we keep upon the 29th day of this present month.
<h>A</h>t Metz, (about the year 400,) the holy Confessor Rufus, Bishop (of that see.)
<h>A</h>t Strasbourg, (about the year 693,) holy Florence, Bishop (of that see, and Founder and Abbot of Haslach and of St. Thomas.)
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>Ant.</r> Qui cælórum cóntines thronum, et abýssos intuéris, Dómine, Rex regum, montes pónderas, terram palmo conclúdis: exáudi nos, Dómine, in gemítibus nostris.

<h>Canticle: Magnificat</h>
<r>Ant.</r> O Lord, the King of kings, That containest the circuit of the heavens and beholdest the depths, That weighest the mountains, and holdest the earth in thine hand, * hear us, O Lord, when we cry unto thee.
<r>Canticle of the Blessed Virgin</r>
<r>Luke 1:46-55</r>
§00.83742356bc
<r>℣.</r> Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
<r>℟.</r> As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
<r>Ant.</r> O Lord, the King of kings, That containest the circuit of the heavens and beholdest the depths, That weighest the mountains, and holdest the earth in thine hand, hear us, O Lord, when we cry unto thee.
